metadata.title: State HMIS report-dimension dictionary
metadata.scope: Metadata for the 35 non-measure columns in the supplied default-column report schema.
boundaries: No data values or original spreadsheet were available for value-domain profiling.
LGD mappings are candidates until exported codes are validated against a dated directory.
HMIS Facility Code, NIN and HFR ID remain distinct identifiers.

officialReferences.name: Local Government Directory
officialReferences.use: Candidate administrative, ULB and constituency reference.

officialReferences.use: Defines NIN as a permanent unique 10-digit facility identifier.

dimensions.definition: Code identifying the state or Union Territory represented by the row.
